title: 第22章 火上浇油
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩趁着刚才那点混乱，已经把手机连上数据线，悄悄塞到灯架旁边的插孔后面。她刚站回镜头前，灯光师的手指就动了。灯光师轻轻拨了一下调光器，没反应。他又拨了一下，还是没反应。灯光师眉头皱起来，低头检查设备，屏幕上的参数明明在跳，可头顶那盏灯就跟没听见似的，纹丝不动。“开拍。”季川的声音从相机后面传来。话音刚落——全场灯光忽然亮了。但不是那种刺眼的亮。所有的光，像商量好似的，齐齐聚在温栩栩身上。柔柔的、软软的，从头顶、从侧面、从四面八方铺过来，不偏不倚，正好把她整个人笼在光圈中央。那光像是长了眼睛。落在温栩栩脸上，把五官的轮廓一点点描出来。眉骨、鼻梁、下颌线，每一处都被雕琢得刚刚好。落在她皮肤上，通透得像是能看见光在里面流动，白得发亮，却不刺眼，反而透着一种温润的质感。温栩栩站在光里，微微侧身，下巴轻抬，认真回忆嫦娥姐姐教的，眼神往季川镜头方向一送——那个角度，那个眼神，那个举手投足的弧度，像是被谁精心设计过，又像是浑然天成。季川的手指顿在快门上。他盯着取景框里的人，愣了一秒。然后——“咔咔咔咔咔——”快门声跟机关枪似的响起来。“好。”“这个角度好。”“别动，就这样。”“头再抬一点？不，就刚才那个位置，回去——对！”“好！”“太好了！”……季川边拍边夸。摄影棚里的所有人看呆了。有人忍不住小声嘀咕：“我去，这新人什么来头？季川这夸得，比我夸我对象还卖力……”旁边的人盯着镜头里的温栩栩，眼睛都直了：“你看看那光，打在她脸上，跟量身定做似的。柔光、侧光、轮廓光，怎么打怎么有，换个人站那儿绝对出不来这效果。”“皮肤也太绝了，通透得发光，根本不用后期修。”“还有那个pose，那个眼神，她真的是素人？”……另一个广告导演已经悄悄摸出名片，攥在手里，随时准备冲上去。旁边的人捅了捅他：“你干嘛？”“抢人啊！等季川拍完，我第一个上去递名片，这位模特下一档期我预定了！”“你做梦吧，轮得到你？没看见前面那排人手里都攥着名片吗？”果然，摄影棚边缘，已经悄悄站了一圈人——副导演、品牌顾问、隔壁棚的摄影师、还有几个不知道哪个公司派来“踩点”的星探。一个个眼睛都看直了，这辈子没见过这么上镜的人！！要不是季川还在这儿拍着，他们早就一拥而上了。林念薇坐在角落里，听着旁边那群人讨论等一下怎么抢温栩栩，脸都给气白了！她手里的奶茶杯子被捏得嘎吱作响，奶茶从吸管口滋出来，溅了一手都没察觉。她辛辛苦苦吆喝来这些人，是来看温栩栩出丑的，不是来给温栩栩送合作送钱的！灯光师站在灯光设备旁边，一脸见了鬼的表情。他低头看着手里的调光器，拨一下，没反应。再拨一下，还是没反应。见鬼了。这灯，怎么就不听使唤了呢？眼看温栩栩越拍越顺，此时林念薇终于坐不住了。她挤过人群快步走到灯光师身边，压低声音，语气里带着咬牙切齿的狠劲：“你干嘛呢？！温栩栩救过你的命啊？”“平时怎么没见你有这打光实力啊？”灯光师脸都白了，疯狂摆手：“不是我！我真的控制不了！”“这灯……它不听我的！”“不听你的？”林念薇气得想扇他，“不是吹自已多牛逼吗？现在连个灯都搞不定？！”而摄影棚中央，季川的声音传来：“好，状态正好，最后三张！”林念薇急了，一把抓住灯光师的胳膊：“快关灯！直接把闸拉了！”灯光师手忙脚乱去够开光——没反应。他又按了几下——还是没反应。那灯，就像被人远程操控着一样，稳稳当当照着温栩栩，一丝一毫都不带抖的。“三张——两张——最后一张——”季川放下相机，难得露出一点满意的神色：“过。收工！”就在季川说收工的话音刚落——“砰！！！”突然，一声巨响，灯光师面前那盏主灯直接炸了。玻璃碎片和火星子四溅，劈头盖脸地砸向站在离灯最近的两个人。“啊——！！！”林念薇尖叫着往后躲，但已经来不及了。火星溅在她新买的那件香家外套上，烫出几个焦黑的洞。碎玻璃崩到她小腿上，划出几道血痕。灯光师脸都被熏黑了一块，头发梢还冒着烟，愣在原地。两个人的脸都像只被烤了一遍的熏鸡。全场安静了一秒。有人赶紧叫医务人员，有人小声嘀咕：“这灯……质量不行啊？”“幸好拍完了才炸，不然今天就白干了。”这么大的动静，温栩栩想不注意都难。她看着那盏还在冒烟的主灯，又看了看灰头土脸的灯光师和狼狈不堪的林念薇，嘴角差点没压住。电母大人这脾气……她太喜欢了！温栩栩赶紧放下手里的拍摄道具，快步走过去火上浇油，哦不，关心林念薇的伤势。她在林念薇面前蹲下来，脸上带着恰到好处的关心：“哎呀，薇薇！你没事吧？”林念薇还没来得及反应，温栩栩已经凑到跟前，上下打量着那件被火星烫出洞的香奈儿外套，语气里全是“心疼”。“薇薇，刚才季摄影师不是说了嘛，让闲杂人等离拍摄现场远一点，你怎么还挤过来了呢？”
content_en: Wen Xuxu took advantage of the confusion just now to connect the phone to the data cable and quietly stuffed it behind the jack next to the light stand.As soon as she stood back in front of the camera, the lighting engineer's fingers moved.The lighting engineer flicked the dimmer, but there was no response.He dialed again, but still no response.The lighting engineer frowned and lowered his head to check the equipment. The parameters on the screen were clearly jumping, but the light above his head seemed not to be heard and remained motionless."Start shooting." Ji Chuan's voice came from behind the camera.As soon as he finished speaking - the lights in the whole place suddenly turned on.But it's not that blindingly bright.All the light, like a discussion, focused on Wen Xuxu.It was soft and soft, spreading from the top of her head, from the sides, and from all directions, without leaning to one side, just enclosing her whole body in the center of the aperture.The light seemed to have eyes.It fell on Wen Xuxu's face and traced the outline of his facial features bit by bit.The brow bones, nose bridge, and jawline are all sculpted to perfection.When it fell on her skin, it was so transparent that you could see light flowing inside. It was so white that it was not dazzling, but had a warm texture.Wen Xuxu stood in the light, turned slightly sideways, raised her chin slightly, and carefully recalled what Sister Chang'e had taught her. She glanced in the direction of Ji Chuan's camera - that angle, that look, that arc of gestures, seemed to have been carefully designed by someone, and it seemed to be natural.Ji Chuan's finger paused on the shutter.He stared at the person in the viewfinder for a second.Then - "Crack, click, click, click -" the shutter sound sounded like a machine gun."Okay." "This is a good angle." "Don't move, that's it." "Raise your head a little higher? No, just go back to the same position - yes!" "Okay!" "Great!"... Ji Chuan praised while patting.Everyone in the studio was stunned.Some people couldn't help but whisper: "Here, what's the background of this newcomer? Ji Chuan praised me harder than I praised my partner..." The people next to her stared at Wen Xuxu in the camera, their eyes straightened: "Look at the light, it hits her face, as if it was tailor-made. Soft light, side light, contour light, whatever you want.No, no one else would have achieved this effect."The skin is so amazing, so translucent, there's no need for post-processing.""And that pose, that look, is she really an amateur?"... Another advertising director has quietly taken out his business card, holding it in his hand, ready to rush forward at any time.The people next to him poked him: "What are you doing?" "Robbing people! When Ji Chuan finishes shooting, I will be the first to go up and hand over the business card. I have booked this model for the next show!" "You dream, it's your turn? Didn't you see that the people in the front row are holding business cards in their hands?" Sure enough, there was a circle of people standing quietly at the edge of the studio - the assistant director, the brand consultant, the photographer from the next studio, and a few talent scouts sent by who knows which company.Everyone's eyes were wide open. I have never seen such a photogenic person in my life!!If Ji Chuan hadn't still been filming here, they would have swarmed over him.Lin Nianwei sat in the corner, her face turned pale with anger as she listened to the group of people next to her discussing how to grab Wen Xuxu later!The milk tea cup in her hand made a squeaking sound, and the milk tea squirted out from the mouth of the straw, splashing onto her hand without even noticing.She worked so hard to shout that these people were here to see Wen Xuxu make a fool of himself, not to cooperate and give money to Wen Xuxu!The lighting engineer stood next to the lighting equipment with an expression on his face that he had seen a ghost.He looked down at the dimmer in his hand and turned it, but there was no response.Dial again, still no response.Damn it.Why doesn't this lamp work?Seeing that Wen Xuxu's shots were getting smoother and smoother, Lin Nianwei finally couldn't sit still.She squeezed through the crowd and walked quickly to the lighting engineer, lowered her voice, and said with gritted teeth: "What are you doing?! Wen Xuxu saved your life?" "Why haven't I seen you with such lighting ability?" The lighting engineer's face turned pale and he waved his hands wildly: "It's not me! I really can't control it!" "This light... it doesn't listen to me!" "It doesn't listen to you.Lin Nianwei was so angry that she wanted to slap him, "Aren't you bragging about how awesome you are? You can't even turn on the lights now?"From the center of the studio, Ji Chuan's voice came: "Okay, the last three shots!"Lin Nianwei grabbed the lighting engineer's arm and said, "Turn off the lights!"The lighting engineer hurriedly reached for the light - there was no response.He pressed it a few more times - still no response.The lamp, as if controlled remotely, shone steadily on Wen Xuxu without any shaking."Three pictures - two - the last one -" Ji Chuan put down the camera, showing a rare look of satisfaction: "That's it. Call it a day!" Just as Ji Chuan said it was time to finish the work - "Bang!!!" Suddenly, there was a loud noise, and the main light in front of the lighting engineer exploded.Glass shards and sparks flew everywhere, hitting the two people standing closest to the lamp."Ah——!!!" Lin Nianwei screamed and hid behind, but it was too late.Sparks splashed on her newly bought Xiangjia jacket, burning several black holes.The broken glass crashed onto her calf, leaving several bloody marks.The lighting engineer's face was completely blackened, and the tips of his hair were still smoking, and he froze in place.Both of their faces looked like smoked chicken that had been roasted over and over again.The whole place was quiet for a second.Some people hurriedly called the medical staff, and some people whispered: "This lamp... is not of good quality?" "Fortunately, it didn't explode until after the shooting, otherwise today's work would have been in vain." It was difficult for Wen Xuxu not to pay attention to such a big movement.She looked at the main lamp that was still smoking, then at the disgraced lighting engineer and the embarrassed Lin Nianwei, and her lips almost stopped.Mother Dian's temper...she likes it so much!Wen Xuxu quickly put down the shooting props in his hand and walked over quickly to add fuel to the fire. Oh no, he was concerned about Lin Nianwei's injury.She knelt down in front of Lin Nianwei, with just the right amount of concern on her face: "Oh, Weiwei! Are you okay?" Before Lin Nianwei had time to react, Wen Xuxu had already moved closer, looking up and down at the Chanel jacket that had been burned with holes by sparks, her tone full of "heartache.""Weiwei, didn't Photographer Ji just say that people should stay away from the shooting site? Why did you still squeeze in?"
